caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a rectangular mechanical or industrial box placed on a flat rectangular base. The box is shaded in gray pencil, with darker shading indicating shadows on the sides and lighter shading on the top surface. On the left side of the top surface, there is a circular component with a handle or lever protruding upward, and a small circular indentation next to it. On the right side of the top surface, there is a rectangular section marked with a grid of small round holes. On the front face of the box, near the bottom and slightly left of center, there is a horizontal cylindrical protrusion. The box and its base are placed within a larger outlined rectangle that frames the drawing. The background is plain, and the only text is located in the lower right corner, reading “Henry Granet.” The drawing uses only shades of gray and appears on off-white or aged paper.
title: Pewter Inkwell
